result.instructions: Tools for RunCloud, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my servers are online and how much memory is free?"; "Which websites are hosted on my main server?"; "When does the SSL certificate for my main website expire?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes RunCloud data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run runcloud_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run runcloud_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run runcloud_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. runcloud_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: runcloud_ping
tools.title: Check API connection
tools.description: Check that the API key works: RunCloud answers with a message ('pong'). GET /ping.

tools.name: runcloud_list_servers
tools.title: List servers
tools.description: List the servers connected to the workspace: id, name, provider, IP address, OS, stack, online/connected state, agent and PHP CLI version, auto-update settings and tags. GET /servers.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: runcloud_get_server
tools.title: Get server
tools.description: One server by id: provider, IP, OS and version, stack, online state, agent version, update settings, tags. GET /servers/{id}.

tools.name: runcloud_get_server_stats
tools.title: Get server counts
tools.description: How many web applications, databases, cron jobs and supervisor jobs a server has, and its country. GET /servers/{id}/stats.

tools.name: runcloud_get_server_hardware
tools.title: Get server hardware info
tools.description: Kernel version, CPU model and cores, memory and disk totals/free, load average and uptime of a server. GET /servers/{id}/hardwareinfo.

tools.name: runcloud_get_server_health
tools.title: Get latest server health
tools.description: The latest health sample of a server: total/available/used memory and disk space (MB) and load average. GET /servers/{id}/health/latest.

tools.name: runcloud_list_server_logs
tools.title: List server activity logs
tools.description: The server's activity log (what was changed in RunCloud and when), newest first. GET /servers/{id}/logs.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: runcloud_list_services
tools.title: List server services
tools.description: The services on a server (nginx, php-fpm, mariadb, redis, supervisor...) with real name, running state, CPU, memory and version. The realName is what runcloud_control_service needs. GET /servers/{id}/services.

tools.name: runcloud_list_system_users
tools.title: List system users
tools.description: The system (Linux) users on a server: id, username, whether deletable. Deployment keys and passwords are never returned. GET /servers/{id}/users.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: runcloud_list_webapps
tools.title: List web applications
tools.description: List the web applications on a server: id, name, root/public path, PHP version, stack, type (wordpress, custom...), default flag, alias. Deployment webhook keys are not returned. GET /servers/{id}/webapps.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: runcloud_get_webapp
tools.title: Get web application
tools.description: One web application by id (path, PHP version, stack, type, default flag). GET /servers/{id}/webapps/{webapp}.

tools.name: runcloud_get_webapp_settings
tools.title: Get web application settings
tools.description: PHP and FPM/Nginx settings of a web application (disabled functions, timezone, memory and upload limits, process manager...). GET /servers/{id}/webapps/{webapp}/settings.

tools.name: runcloud_list_webapp_logs
tools.title: List web application activity logs
tools.description: The activity log of a web application (settings changes, PHP version changes, deployments), newest first. GET /servers/{id}/webapps/{webapp}/log.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: runcloud_list_domains
tools.title: List domain names
tools.description: The domain names of a web application: id, name, type (primary/alias), www, redirection, wildcard, DNS integration, status. GET /servers/{id}/webapps/{webapp}/domains.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: runcloud_get_domain_dns
tools.title: Get domain DNS setup instructions
tools.description: The DNS records (A, CNAME...) a domain name needs to point at the server. GET /servers/{id}/webapps/{webapp}/domains/{domain}/dns.

tools.name: runcloud_get_webapp_ssl
tools.title: Get web application SSL
tools.description: The web application's SSL certificate (basic / web-app-level SSL): provider, validity, HTTPS settings. Private keys are never returned. GET /servers/{id}/webapps/{webapp}/ssl.

tools.name: runcloud_get_ssl_method
tools.title: Check SSL method and AutoSSL status
tools.description: Whether the web application uses basic (one certificate for the app) or advanced (one per domain) SSL, and its AutoSSL status. Advanced SSL is a Business/Enterprise feature. GET /servers/{id}/webapps/{webapp}/ssl/advanced.

annotations.title: Check SSL method and AutoSSL status

tools.name: runcloud_get_git_deployment
tools.title: Get Git deployment
tools.description: The Git deployment configured on a web application: provider, branch, repository URL, auto-deploy flag, deployment script and whether it is an atomic deployment. The deployment webhook keys are not returned. The id of the result is the git_id for runcloud_deploy_git. GET /servers/{id}/webapps/{webapp}/git.

tools.name: runcloud_list_databases
tools.title: List databases
tools.description: The databases on a server: id, name, collation. No credentials. GET /servers/{id}/databases.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: runcloud_list_database_users
tools.title: List database users
tools.description: The database users on a server (id, username). Passwords are never returned. GET /servers/{id}/databaseusers.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: runcloud_list_cronjobs
tools.title: List cron jobs
tools.description: The cron jobs of a server: id, label, user, schedule, command, enabled flag. The id is what runcloud_run_cronjob needs. GET /servers/{id}/cronjobs.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: runcloud_list_supervisors
tools.title: List supervisor jobs
tools.description: The supervisor (background worker) jobs of a server: id, label, user, process count, auto start/restart, directory, command. GET /servers/{id}/supervisors.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: runcloud_get_supervisor_status
tools.title: Get supervisor job status
tools.description: The live status (RUNNING, FATAL, BACKOFF...), pid and uptime of every supervisor process, by job label. GET /servers/{id}/supervisors/status.

tools.name: runcloud_list_firewall_rules
tools.title: List firewall rules
tools.description: The firewall rules of a server: type (global/rich), port, protocol, IP address, action. GET /servers/{id}/security/firewalls.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: runcloud_list_blocked_ips
tools.title: List Fail2Ban blocked IPs
tools.description: The IP addresses Fail2Ban currently blocks on a server. GET /servers/{id}/security/fail2ban/blockedip.

tools.name: runcloud_list_backups
tools.title: List backups
tools.description: The backup instances of the workspace: label, what they cover (web app / database), storage, type, frequency, size, status. Filter by server, storage, status or name. GET /backups.

server_id.description: Only backups of this server id.

storage.description: Storage type, e.g. runcloud or local.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: runcloud_list_backup_snapshots
tools.title: List backup snapshots
tools.description: The snapshots of one backup instance: run date, status, type and size. GET /backups/{id}/snapshots.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: runcloud_list_atomic_projects
tools.title: List atomic deployment projects
tools.description: The atomic Git deployment projects of the workspace: name, provider, repository, branch, auto-deploy, success/failure counts and the latest deployment. Webhook keys are not returned. GET /atomic.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: runcloud_list_atomic_deployments
tools.title: List atomic deployments
tools.description: The deployments of an atomic project: commit hash, branch, message, committer, release name, status (DEPLOYING, COMPLETED, FAILED), start and end time. GET /atomic/{project}/deployments.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: runcloud_control_service
tools.title: Start, restart or reload a service
tools.description: WRITE: run systemctl start, restart or reload on one service of a server (for example nginx-rc or php81rc-fpm). A restart briefly interrupts that service and the sites behind it. 'stop' is deliberately not offered. Get the realName from runcloud_list_services. PATCH /servers/{id}/services.

real_name.description: The service's realName from runcloud_list_services, e.g. nginx-rc or redis-server.

annotations.title: Start, restart or reload a service

tools.name: runcloud_deploy_git
tools.title: Force a Git deployment
tools.description: WRITE: force a Git deployment of a web application now: RunCloud pulls the configured branch and runs the deployment script, which changes the live site's files. Get git_id from runcloud_get_git_deployment (its id). PUT /servers/{id}/webapps/{webapp}/git/{git}/script.

tools.name: runcloud_force_deploy_atomic
tools.title: Force an atomic deployment
tools.description: WRITE: start an atomic deployment of a project now (builds a new release and switches the live symlink when it succeeds). PUT /atomic/{project}/forcedeploy.

tools.name: runcloud_run_cronjob
tools.title: Run a cron job now
tools.description: WRITE: force-run one cron job of a server once, right now, outside its schedule. The job's command runs on the server with its configured user. Get the id from runcloud_list_cronjobs. POST /servers/{id}/cronjobs/{job}/run.

tools.name: runcloud_reload_supervisor
tools.title: Reload a supervisor job
tools.description: WRITE: reload one supervisor job so its worker processes restart (running processes are interrupted). Get the id from runcloud_list_supervisors. POST /servers/{id}/supervisors/{job}/reload.

tools.name: runcloud_renew_ssl
tools.title: Renew a Let's Encrypt certificate
tools.description: WRITE: redeploy (renew) the Let's Encrypt certificate of a web application, which re-issues it and reloads the web server. Let's Encrypt certificates only. For basic SSL pass the ssl_id from runcloud_get_webapp_ssl; for advanced (per-domain) SSL, which requires advanced SSL mode (check runcloud_get_ssl_method), also pass domain_id. PUT /servers/{id}/webapps/{webapp}/ssl/{ssl} or /domains/{domain}/ssl/{ssl}.

domain_id.description: Only for advanced (per-domain) SSL mode (see runcloud_get_ssl_method): the domain's id.

tools.name: runcloud_install_letsencrypt_ssl
tools.title: Issue a Let's Encrypt certificate
tools.description: WRITE: issue and install a free Let's Encrypt certificate for a web application (basic SSL) or for one domain of it (advanced SSL, pass domain_id; this requires advanced SSL mode, see runcloud_get_ssl_method). The web server is reloaded; the domain's DNS must already point at the server. Custom certificates are not supported here. POST /servers/{id}/webapps/{webapp}/ssl or /domains/{domain}/ssl.

domain_id.description: Only for advanced (per-domain) SSL mode (see runcloud_get_ssl_method): the domain's id.

authorization_method.description: Let's Encrypt challenge: http-01, or dns-01 (needs external_api, a Cloudflare DNS integration).

external_api.description: Id of the Cloudflare DNS integration; required for dns-01.

environment.description: live (default, trusted certificate) or staging (test certificate).

enable_http.description: Keep plain HTTP enabled alongside HTTPS.

enable_hsts.description: Send the HSTS header (browsers will insist on HTTPS).

prompts.title: Get started with RunCloud
